feature.name: OSD MESSAGES
feature.description: Display on screen information like savestate, config warning etc...

feature.name: OSD MESSAGES POSITION
feature.description: Choose the on-screen position for system messages.

feature.name: OSD PERFORMANCE POSITION
feature.description: Choose the on-screen position for performance metrics (FPS, CPU usage, etc.).

feature.name: GAME ASPECT RATIO
feature.description: Force the game to render in this aspect ratio. Not all systems support all ratios.

feature.name: FMV ASPECT RATIO
feature.description: Adjusts Full Motion Video movies aspect ratio.

feature.name: DEINTERLACING
feature.description: FMV movie deinterlacing.

feature.name: BILINEAR FILTERING
feature.description: Smooths the overall picture as it is displayed on the screen. Corrects positioning between pixels.

feature.name: ENABLE WIDESCREEN PATCHES
feature.description: Enhancement. Only works with a 16/9 ratio and bezels disabled.

feature.name: ANTI-BLUR
feature.description: Enable to improve bluriness.

feature.name: VSYNC
feature.description: Fix screen tearing. CPU heavy.

feature.name: INTERLACING PATCHES
feature.description: Enable No-interlacing Patches.

feature.name: INTEGER SCALING
feature.description: Can sharpen images in lower resolutions.

feature.name: GRAPHICS API
feature.description: Choose which graphics API library to use.

feature.name: RENDERING RESOLUTION
feature.description: Enhancement. Increase the rendering resolution. Makes 3D objects clearer.

feature.name: MIPMAPPING
feature.description: Choose mipmapping type.

feature.name: TEXTURE FILTERING
feature.description: Control the texture filtering of the emulation.

feature.name: TRILINEAR FILTERING
feature.description: Control the texture's trilinear filtering of the emulation.

feature.name: ANISOTROPIC FILTERING
feature.description: Improves clarity of distant textures.

feature.name: DITHERING
feature.description: Reduces banding between colours and improves the preceived colour depth.

feature.name: BLENDING ACCURACY
feature.description: The higher the setting, the more blending is emulated in the shader accurately, and the higher the speed penalty will be.

feature.name: TEXTURE PRELOADING
feature.description: Uploads entire textures at once instead of small pieces. Improves performance in most games.

feature.name: SHOW BIOS BOOTLOGO
feature.description: Some games have issues when the animation is shown, others require it.

feature.name: FXAA
feature.description: Applies the FXAA anti-aliasing algorithm to improve the visual quality of games.

feature.name: CHEATS
feature.description: Automatically loads and applies cheats on game start.

feature.name: MULTITAP
feature.description: Allows up to 8 controllers in supported games.

feature.name: TEXTURE REPLACEMENTS
feature.description: Allows user replaceable textures.

feature.name: TIME CRISIS FOG HACK
feature.description: Necessary for some guns to replace fog textures as a workaround in Time Crisis - Crisis Zone.

feature.name: WHEEL MODEL
feature.description: Playstation 2 wheel type

feature.name: MAME HOOKER OUTPUT
feature.description: Send output signals to MameOutputSender for recoil/light gun effects via Hook of the Reaper.
